item.description: The View.__getattr__ method raises AttributeError when trying to access attributes like 'f', 'add', 'do' that exist on Signal objects but not on the View, instead of properly delegating to the underlying Signal.
item.contract: When accessing an attribute on a View that doesn't exist as a field in the layout, the method should check if the attribute exists on the underlying Signal object and delegate appropriately, rather than raising AttributeError.

item.description: The View.__getattr__ method incorrectly raises AttributeError for reserved names (starting with underscore) instead of allowing indexing access as expected by the tests.
item.contract: When accessing a field with a reserved name (starting with underscore) via attribute access, the method should raise AttributeError suggesting indexing instead, rather than raising a generic AttributeError.

item.description: The View.__getattr__ method does not provide helpful error messages when accessing missing fields, instead raising generic AttributeError without suggestions.
item.contract: When a field doesn't exist on a View, the method should provide helpful error messages suggesting similar field names to aid debugging.

item.description: The Layout._convert_to_int method fails to properly validate reset values for Signal construction, particularly with non-constant-castable values like dictionaries.
item.contract: When constructing Signals with reset values, the reset values should be validated to be constant-castable expressions, and appropriate TypeError should be raised for invalid values.

item.description: The View.__getitem__ method does not properly validate array indexing with non-array layouts, raising misleading error messages.
item.contract: When attempting to index a non-array layout with a Value, the method should raise a TypeError with a clear message indicating that only array layouts support dynamic indexing.
